info.name: Cox’s Bazar Rest House API
info.description: Run login first. Mutations change data: run individual operations in a test environment. Set booking_id/version from current detail. Leave retry_idempotency_key blank for new actions, pin it only for an identical retry. Binary requests return private files; use Send and Download. Twilio callback requires a valid provider signature.
